# PostUp mockups

> Static mockups of the PostUp app (v1034): 41 screens plus overlay sheets, four styles, phone and desktop. Each screen has implementation notes (purpose, behavior, links, states, copy, decisions with sources, and Overrides where a later decision beats the drawing). Read the notes with the screen.

Mockup URL pattern: /mockups/?style=<fresh|cozy|night|bold>&device=<phone|desktop>&auth=<out|in>&live=<live|none>#<screen> (overlays: &ov=<sheet>)
The home page (/) is #home, called Home, with two modes on one URL: Live and Building (?mode=live|building). #home-overlay-alt is an alternative, not chosen. #quiet is the old no-live home drawing; #quiet-feed / #quiet-feed-b are Nearby (/nearby). Project lists are headed "What people are building", sorted closest-first, showing the closest available even if none are local; never call them nearby unless they are (Martin, Oct 18).

## Model (source of truth for screens, links, notes, flows)
- [Concepts: screen, slot, link, site state, flow](model/CONCEPTS.md) · [Index of every screen and flow](model/INDEX.md) · files: model/screens/*.toml, model/flows/*.toml, model/events.toml, model/global.toml
- Site state id: page[+child]@auth.live[.tab], e.g. postup+signin@out.live. Sheets open in a page's sheet slot; the phone tab bar and desktop rail are tab/panel slots. Sign-in is one sheet (old #join-signin, #ask-signin, #post-signin, #attach-signin URLs redirect to it).

## Notes
- [All screens in one file](notes/all.md): global rules, every screen, every source quote

## Critical flows
Critical flows (Martin, Oct 24 2026 [M1024]): a type of user arrives in a certain situation and goes through a scenario step by step. Each step names the screen and the scenario params (auth, live, Home mode, sheet). Flows marked Draft were inferred from the screen notes; confirm with Martin.
- [All flows in one file](flows/all.md)
- [look-around](flows/look-around.md): Newcomer looks around, then joins (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/look-around.html
- [empty-area-newcomer](flows/empty-area-newcomer.md): Nobody live nearby (newcomer) (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/empty-area-newcomer.html
- [join](flows/join.md): Join someone live (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/join.html
- [invite-live](flows/invite-live.md): Share link to a live postup (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/invite-live.html
- [empty-area](flows/empty-area.md): Nobody live nearby (signed in) (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/empty-area.html
- [first-post](flows/first-post.md): Came to post up: first post with sign-in (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/first-post.html
- [returning-post](flows/returning-post.md): Returning poster (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/returning-post.html
- [hosting](flows/hosting.md): Hosting live: extend, edit, end (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/hosting.html
- [chat](flows/chat.md): Postup chat (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/chat.html
- [safety](flows/safety.md): Report and block (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/safety.html
- [leave](flows/leave.md): Leave a postup you joined (Phase 1, draft) · player: flows/leave.html
- [invite-project](flows/invite-project.md): Share link to a project (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/invite-project.html
- [ask-join](flows/ask-join.md): Ask to join, then get approved (joiner side) (Phase 2 (MVP), draft) · player: flows/ask-join.html
- [host-approve](flows/host-approve.md): Host approves a request (Phase 2 (MVP), draft) · player: flows/host-approve.html
- [project-builder](flows/project-builder.md): Project builder: create, update, post up for it (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/project-builder.html
- [following](flows/following.md): Follow a person or project (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/following.html
- [postup-states](flows/postup-states.md): Postup ends, fills or is cancelled while you look (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/postup-states.html
- [loading-offline](flows/loading-offline.md): Slow network and offline (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/loading-offline.html
- [delete-account](flows/delete-account.md): Delete account (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/delete-account.html

- [settings-notify](flows/settings-notify.md): Notification settings and sign out (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/settings-notify.html
- [catch-up](flows/catch-up.md): Catch up on what happened (Unphased, draft) · player: flows/catch-up.html

## Site graph
Site graph (Martin, Oct 25 2026 [M1025]): 40 pages + 9 sheets, 336 site states (page [+ child in a slot] × auth out|in × live (nearby) live|none, Home × tab), 3666 edges from the model (model/: screen links, tab bar and rail chrome slots, events, conditions). A flow is a path of steps, each a link (screen:id) or event that reaches the expected site state. Site-state id: page[+child]@auth.live[.tab]. See model/CONCEPTS.md. [M1031-draft]
- [Site graph: pages, site states, edges, design gaps](flows/sitegraph.md) · page: flows/site.html · data: flows/sitegraph.json
- [Site states by screen](flows/states.html): every state each screen appears in (conditions, open slots, links in/out, flow steps), from model/
- [Site map + states (split view)](flows/explore.html): click a screen on the map, see all its site states

## Flow map
Flow map (Martin, Oct 25 2026 [M1025]): a state machine from a first-time visitor (signed out, never registered) to the starting point of every critical flow. User states are grouped into four boxes, left to right: Arrive (first-time visitors split by intent: stumbled on it, curious about content, came to post up, opened a share link), Signed out browsing, Signed in, Doing something. Arrows are events or conditions (dashed = going back). Each flow’s badge sits inside the state where it starts (green = MVP must, grey = nice) and opens the flow player. All 22 flows are reachable from the root.
- [Flow map (Mermaid source + where each flow starts)](flows/map.md) · page: flows/map.html
- [Flow map by situation](flows/map.html): per user type (#newcomer, #registered), situations with their flows; data model/situations.toml
